snippet.title: TURBOCIDE Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
TURBOCIDE

A New Type of Party Shooter!
 Simple controls. Fast action.



🕹 What is TURBOCIDE?
 Defeat Others, chain your kills, and power up!

Every elimination makes you move faster and shine brighter.



🎮 How to Play

Pick up weapons on the map. No loadouts. Everyone starts equal.


Stay on the move. Jump pads, lifts, and wide arenas keep the pace high.


Choose your fights wisely. Small weapons for steady play. Power weapons for big moments.


Work together… or don’t. Team Deathmatch, Free-for-All, or Capture the Core!






✨ Key Features

Killchains – The more you eliminate, the stronger you feel.


Arena Maps – Designed for fast loops, vertical fights, and exciting comebacks.






🌟 Why It’s Fun

Heavy but easy-to-control movement.


Weapons that feel good — from precise Railguns to wild Rocket Cores.


Visual effects and announcer calls make every killchain exciting.


Big plays are celebrated so everyone feels the thrill together.






💡 Our Goal
 A party shooter where the real reward is sharing the chaos.

WISHLIST ON STEAM NOW
